scope: Offline native level-fixture visual and geometry review only. No runtime, new human approval or publication pass.

findings.description: Curved seat geometry is now assembled on its dedicated connected seating pads; the prior slat intrusion across central paths is absent. Two pergola rooms, planted quadrants, raised entrance herb beds and generous loop/cross routes retain sensory-garden identity.

2115 full-width material-aware walking rays and eight roots pass on exact assembly. Six independently reimported module types have finite metric envelopes and native ground datums; curved seats inspected directly in programme close-up.

Planting groups are simpler and less botanically varied than the photographic concept and conservatory benchmark. Native geometry remains coherent, readable and materially separated; botanical variety can improve later without blocking classroom concept use.
